Who are anxious, restless, do everything in great haste; must change posi on o en; everything startles him; remains disquiet. 3. Music is unbearable, makes her sad. 4. Disposed to mental, nervous troubles, conges ons, haemorrhage, neuralgias. It is a SPECIFIC remedy for the following condi ons: 1. Aphonia, Tonsilli s, Croup, Laryngi s, Bronchi s, Pneumonia, pleurisy, O s and other inﬂammatory diseases from exposure to cold winds or cold air. 2. Reten on of urine from shock. 3. Amenorrhoea in plethoric young girls a er fright. 4. Complaints a er hair cut. 5. Pains are unbearable, they drive him to despair or crazy; worse at night, make him toss about in agony; facial neuralgia, toothache, orchi s, pleurisy, pericardi s, etc. 6. Asthma from ac ve hyperaemia of lungs. 7. Fever: skin dry hot; face red, or pale and red alternately; burning thirst for large quan es of cold water; with intense, nervous restlessness, anxiety and fear; whole body burning hot. 8. Convulsions of teething children with high fever. 9. Haemorrhages: bright red blood; with anxiety and fear of death. 10. Dysentery: when Merc though indicated fails. 11. Ailments: with vanishing of sight suddenly; fain ng; red face becomes pale on rising from recumbent posi on; hot dry skin; unconquerable anxiety, restlessness; anxiety with fear, fear of death; predicts the me of death. 14. sections.title: Details
sections.content: IT IS A SHORT ACTING REMEDY. It is a CONSTITUTIONAL remedy for the following types of pa ents: 1. Sanguine plethoric persons of very red face and lively expression. 2. Nervous persons who cannot bear pain. 3. Persons who remain long impressed by even slightest mechanical injuries. 4. Apathe c persons who say "there is nothing the ma er with him" even when he is seriously ill, sends the doctor away and wants to be le alone. 5. Pa ents : who worry and exaggerate trivial symptoms. 6. Pa ents : sullen morose, don not speak a word, do not want to be talked to. 7. Pa ents : who are fearful but fear remains at night a er an accident. (Fear persists day and night-Op). 8. Horror of instant death with cardiac distress at night. It is a SPECIFIC remedy for the following condi ons: 1. Bad eﬀects of mechanical injury even of remote origin. Bruised pain, soreness, haemorrhage, extravasa on of blood, epistaxis a er a fall or blow from a blunt weapon. 3. Concussion with stupor, meningi s, shock a er head injury (Nat s). 4. Black eye, re nal haemorrhage from a blow to the eye; or severe cough. 5. Apoplexy: helps in the absorp on of blood a er Op high. 6. Paralysis: le sided with pulse full and strong; sighing, mu ering and stertorous breathing; with unconsciousness. 7. Gout of great toe: with great fear of being touched or stuck by a person coming near him. 8. Prevents post-partum haemorrhage and puerperal complica ons if given just a er delivery. 9. Hypertrophy of heart from heart strain and over work. 10. Reten on of urine from injuries or constant dribbling of urine a er labor. DOSAGE : In all recent aﬀec ons it may be given in lower potencies, but for the remote eﬀects of injury we must ascend the region of inﬁnites mals. (Hughes). Higher potencies are found useful in "Nausea" and vomi ng with disgust for food, diarrhoea and dysentery (Underwood). REPETITION : To be repeated in recent injuries ll a favourable response is no ced. For injuries long ago single dose of higher e.g. 200 C. In apoplexy lower potencies must be repeated for some days.

sections.title: Details
sections.content: It is one of the most frequently used remedy in both acute and chronic diseases. It is a short ac ng medicine and not very deep in its ac on, therefore when it has relieved the acute symptoms a complementary or miasma c remedy should be given to cure the sick individual. It is a CONSTITUTIONAL remedy in pa ents: 1. Who are extremely fas dious, cri cal and dy. 2. Who are chilly, worse from cold, cold drinks, cold food, be er from heat and covering. 3. Who are anxious, restless, fearful, depressed and melancholic. 4. Who are vexed easily, irritable, peevish and full of anguish, 5. Who are allergic to ice cream, fruits, bad meat, ﬁsh strong cheese. 6. Teething children are pale, weak fre ul, want to be carried rapidly. 7. Who are worse a er midnight (1 to 2 A.M. or P.M. ). 8. Who cannot bear the smell or sight of food (Colch, Sep). It is SPECIFIC remedy for the following condi ons: 1. Ailments from alcohol, chewing tobacco, sausage poisoning, dissec ng wound, bites of venomous insects, anthrax, sea bathing, ptomaine poisoning, malaria, abuse of quinine, iodine, climbing mountains. 2. Ailments from care worry, grief fright and shock. 3. Ailments with great prostra on and rapid sinking of vital forces, rapid emacia on, despair of recovery; worse when alone; aggravated form physical exer on. 4. Burning pains relieved from warm applica ons. 5. Vomi ng and diarrhoea with anxiety and restlessness from ice- cream. 6. Cholera : with cold perspira on, thirst for small quan es of water extreme prostra on, cadaveric appearance foul stool and vomit, restlessness, anxiety and fear of death. 7. Dropsy : with thirst for small quan es of water, restlessness, anxiety and prostra on. 8. Anaemia: cancerous aﬀec ons; collapse; fain ng; inﬂamma ons; gangrene; ulcers; psoriasis; scabies; ur caria; coryza; hay fever; aphthae; ﬁssured tongue; diphtheria; dysentery; diabetes; leucorrhoea; asthma; pneumonia; pericardi s; phthisis; syphilis: with cons tu onal and characteris c symptoms of Ars a. 9. Delirium: with depression, restlessness, fear of death, fear of being alone and strong suicidal tendency. (Talco ). 10. Acute nephri s following exanthemata; with convulsions; puﬃness of face, mental anguish and suppressed urine; with uraemic delusions (Canth, Merc cor, Ver vir). 11. Herpes zoster: pains burning, shoo ng, s cking; worse at night; with restlessness, thirst for small quan es of water, black colour of the exudate. 12. Anaemia : a er acute fevers, haemorrhages with inability to retain food or drink due to irritability of stomach; great restlessness. DOSAGE : Lower potencies are used in malignant ssue and blood diseases e.g. , anaemia, leukaemia, cancer, malarial cachexia, psoriasis etc. Higher potencies are used in nervous and mental ailments. Highest potencies act brilliantly when the general and keynote characteris c symptoms are present. It should not be used in pa ents with very low vitality even if the characteris c symptoms of the remedy are present as it may produce, rapid death without pain. REPETITION : The remedy may be repeated frequently in rapidly developing diseases; e.g. , in cholera low potencies of Ars a, may be repeated every 10 minutes ll the condi on improves. DURATION OF ACTION : It may act over 30 days in chronic condi ons.

As Hahnemann knew Arabic and came to know these medicinal proper es of gold, he tried to prepare potencies of gold and proved it and found the Arabian physicians were right in using gold on the basis of these symptoms.

Acute hepa s: liver is congested, inﬂamed and enlarged; s tching pains in the right hypochondrium, worse from mo on or changing posi on; be er from lying on the right or painful side; jaundice brought on by a ﬁt of anger. 16. Acute pericardi s: of rheuma c origin, s tching pains worse from movement; be er from lying on painful side; fric on rub is present. 17. Pneumonia: it comes a er Acon, Ferr p. Ver vir. Acute rheuma sm: joints red hot and swollen; painful on slightest mo on; touch and pressure aggravate; pains s tching or tearing in character, copious exuda on in joint, with perspira on which relieves. 19. It has exhaus on and stomach inability one desire to keep quiet of Arsenic and of Bryonia (Kent). It is a SPECIFIC remedy for the following condi ons: 1. Yellow fever with black vomi ng; prostra on but worse from mo on, with headache. 2. Paraly c weakness of one side of the body, one arm and leg a er an apoplec c a ack (Caust, Phos). 3. Who feel be er on lying on knee chest posi on, be er at sea side, be er in wet weather, be er from lying on abdomen. It is a SPECIFIC remedy for the following condi ons: 1. Fiery red rash developing about anus in babies a few days old. (Thomas Wildes). Baby's water (urine) scalds terribly. (T. W). 2. Cholera infantum with opisthotonos; vomi ng and diarrhoea of extremely weak and emaciated children; foul smelling stool passed involuntarily; ichorous discharges from rectum. Acute bowel troubles of rickety children (Gilbert). 3. Mongolism of children; with history of gonorrhoea in parents; with characteris c symptoms of medorrhinum. Oﬀensive body odours of syco c children (Clarke); marasmus in infants (Kent). 4. Ailments of women whose breasts and nipples are very sensi ve and sore to touch; breasts cold as ice especially the nipples, while the rest of the body warm especially during menses (H.C. Allen). 5. (Kent). 6. Ailments with the following concomitant symptoms; burning of hands and feet, wants, them not only uncovered but fanned; enlargements of lymph glands; spinal curvatures or pronounced traces of rickets; insa ate craving for liquor which before she hated; with albuminuria with some pus cells: can pass stool by leaning far back, intense restlessness and ﬁdgety legs and feet. 7. Scia ca: le sided; pain worse early morning; be er at sea side. 8. Asthma: be er from lying on knee-chest posi on; be er when at se side; during wet weather. 9. Renal colic with sensa on of passing of calculus. DOSAGE : High and highest potencies. REPETITION : Single dose is the rule. DURATION OF ACTION : Not deﬁnite.

Membranous croup. (H.C. A) 7. Pseudo-membranous forma on extends all over fauces and down throat (H.C. A) 8. Diphtheria with following concomitant symptoms: coldness, cyanosis, swea ng, trembling, haemorrhagic tendency, tongue brown or black, profuse saliva on, nausea. 9. It may be used as a preven ve remedy when the genus epidemicus for Diphtheria corresponds. (H.C. A) 10. Ulcera ons of mouth have a gray membrance. (Boericke) 11. sections.title: Details
sections.content: It is one of the remedies for the emergencies and is found to be SPECIFIC for the following condi ons: 1. Ailments: from fear, fright, anger; shame, sudden joy, sun, alcohol, charcoal fumes and lead. 2. Apoplexy: of drunkards; from fright; with stertorous breathing, jaw dropped, pupils dilated or contracted, face mo led, purple or not, hot sweat, one sided paralysis. 3. Convulsions: from fright; den on; approach of strangers; suppressed exanthema; uraemic; cerebro-spinal meningi s; puerperal fever; during sleep and followed by deep sleep; shrikes, screams before and during convulsion; without consciousness; face red; pupils contracted with opisthotonose; head drawn back; kicks the cover oﬀ; wants a cool room; worse from hot bath. 4. Epilepsy; da ng back to a fright, the object comes before eyes and the fear of the fright remains, recent cases; during sleep; with ver go; with drowsiness; iner a; topper; absence of sensa on; absence of reac on. 5. Delirium tremens: in old emaciated persons; bloated face, stupor, eyes burning, with loud snoring. 6. Delirium: constantly talking; eyes wide open; face red, puﬀed; eyes glassy; half closed; unconscious; followed by stupor and ﬁnally the coma sets in. 7. Ailments; with insensibility; par al or complete paralysis; with great sopor; complains nothing wants nothing; thinks she is not at home; picking of bed clothes during sleep; sleeps with stertorous breathing; with hot sweats; loss of breath on falling asleep; with no desire for stool for days; with reten on of urine in bladder. 8. Ulcers : with acuteness of hearing and acuteness of smell; with great sopor; no desire for stool for days; with delirium, constantly talking with eyes wide open; unconscious; diarrhoea involuntary, oﬀensive stool; great weakness and collapse. 9. Typhoid fever: with acuteness of hearing and acuteness of smell; with great sopor; no desire for stool for days; with delirium, constantly talking with eyes wide open; unconscious; diarrhoea involuntary, oﬀensive stool; great weakness and collapse. 10. Paralysis; Lead; of tongue with great diﬃculty in ar cula on; of pharynx with inability to swallow; of intes ne with tympanic distension; of rectum with no desire for stool or involuntary stools; of bladder and sphincter with reten on or involuntary stools; of bladder and sphincter with reten on or involuntary urina on. DOSAGE : Low to high potencies. 6 c-200 c. REPETITION : Single does; to be repeated when the symptoms call for it. Repeated doses in apoplexy. DURATION OF ACTION : 7 days (Clarke).

sections.content: It is a CONSTITUTIONAL remedy for the following types of pa ents: 1. Who are sensi ve to cold. 2. Who are worse from thinking of their complaints, especially pains. 3. Who are worse from exer on. 4. Who are allergic to sour fruits like strawberries, cranberries, apples, tomatoes, grapes. (Kent). 5. Who are allergic to coﬀee; it produces diarrhoea. 6. Who are worse a er ea ng sugar, starchy food, wine. 7. Who pas oxalate of lime in their urine. It is a SPECIFIC remedy for the following condi ons: 1. Cardiac complaints: with loss of voice; palpita on alterna ng with loss of voice; with diﬃcult breathing; sudden forced expira on in angina pectoris; dyspnoea with constric on of larynx; cardiac cough on slight exer on; pain in middle of chest goes to the back; s tching tearing pains behind the sternum going to shoulders and arms; violent palpita on in rheuma c subjects worse when thinking about it; ﬂu ering heart. Palpita on from lying. 2. Pains : violent; in streaks, in streaks, like lightning; in spots; burning; neuralgic; from le lower chest to epigastrium; worse from mo on and when thinking of them; tender spot pains on the scalp. Cu ng, shoo ng s tching, tearing pains in many parts. Sores and bruised all over the body. (Kent). 3. Burning: in forehead, stomach, abdomen, throat, urethra, hands and feet. 4. Headache: from wine: worse from lying; a er sleep; before and during stool; be er a er stool. 5. Epistaxis with vanishing of sight. 6. Ulcers on gums; gums bleed and are painful in spots; aphthae in mouth. Sour taste, loss of taste; chronic sore throat, has to clear constantly the mucus from the throat. 7. Stomach : eructa ons sour, tasteless a er ea ng; sugar increases pain in stomach; nausea during pregnancy. Paroxysmal pains in abdomen in the night relieved by passing ﬂatus. Burning in stomach and throat. Pains in abdomen are worse when thinking of them. DOSAGE : 6th to 30th potency. REPETITION : Single dose is the rule for higher potencies. DURATION OF ACTION: Not deﬁnite.

sections.title: Details
sections.content: It is a CONSTITUTIONAL remedy for the following types of pa ents: 1. Children: pale face, blue eyes, like fun and caresses; weepy; want company; averse to warmth; no two stools alike. 2. Girls ﬂeshy, aﬀec onate, mild gentle, mid; weeps easily; with scanty, too late, intermi ent ﬂow; delayed ﬁrst menses; derangements at puberty; feel uncomfortable in warm and closed room, be er in open air. Epilepsy with absence or irregularity of menses; milk in breast from ght clothing's. Women: weep while giving out symptoms to the doctor; like company and consola on; symptoms ever changing, must have fresh air; threatened abor on, ﬂow ceases and then returns with increased force; pains spasmodic, excite suﬀoca on and fain ng; suppressed menses from wet feet; intermi ent, changeable and clo ed; chilliness a ended with menses; leucorrhoea acid, excoria ng, and burning; diarrhoea during or a er menses. Helps in normalising the malposi on of foetus and spurious labour pains; useful in complaints of pregnancy like vomi ng, diarrhoea, heart burn and bladder trouble retained placenta. 4. Pa ents, anaemic, chloro c, who have taken much iron, quinine and tonics, even years before; who are worsely aﬀected by taking rich, fat, indiges ble food; worse in the evening at twilight; who feel chilly in warm room, awake unrefreshed a er sleep; the ﬁrst serious impairment of health is referred to puberty." Never been well since"- anaemia, chlorosis, bronchi s; phthisis; symptoms ever changing; pains rapidly shi ing from one part to another; pains a ended with chilliness; the more severe the pain the more severe the chill; pains appear suddenly and leave gradually; thirstlessness with nearly all complaints; great dryness of mouth in the morning without thirst; all gone sensa on in stomach in tea drinkers; discharges thick, bland and yellowish green; want head high on two pillows; lie with hands above head; worse from le ng the aﬀected limb hang down. It is a SPECIFIC remedy for the following condi ons: 1. Diarrhoea: only or usually at night; soon as they eat; from fruits, impure water, cold food or drinks; no two stools alike, changeable. 2. Styes : especially on upper lid; from ea ng fat, rich food or pork. 3. Toothache: worse from warm things and heat of the room; relieved by holding cold water in the mouth (Bry, Coﬀ); during pregnancy. 4. Metastasis of mumps to tes cles or mammae. 5. Gonorrhoeal orchi s; rheuma sm; stricture of urethra, urine passes only in drops. 6. Ailments from fats, rich food fruits, ge ng feet wet, suppressed menses, exposure to cold, pregnancy. 7. Otalgia worse at night; be er from cold applica ons. 8. Sub-acute conjunc vi s with dyspepsia; worse in warm room. 9. Dysentery : with mucus and blood, with chilliness, no two stools alike. 10. Cough : from fa y food; urine emi ed with cough (Caust); a er measles. 11. Ur caria : a er rich food; from delayed menses; worse undressing; with diarrhoea. 12. Malarial fever : with absence of thirst in all stages; one sided sweats. 13. Catarrhal conjunc vi s, worse from warm applica on and be er from cold applica on. (Kali s). 14. Incon nence of urine in young girls who have leucorrhoea; the desire comes on suddenly and they wet their clothes or bed; urine is turbid. 15. Hydrocele with Pulsa lla temperament and characteris c symptoms. 16. Incipient tuberculosis with delayed menses; with cough and loss of weight. 17. Sterility due to profuse chronic leucorrhoea. 18. Phantum pregnancy; woman imagines that she is pregnant with other symptoms of Puls. 19. One of the best remedies to begin with in the treatment of a chronic case. 20. Asthma of children who are allergic to fats, rich food, fruits. 21. Asthma of women with irregular menses. 22. Ailments with chill, weeping easily, thick and bland discharges, changing or contradictory symptoms; worse in evening, worse lying on le side; thirstlessness; desire cool open air. 23. Chronic nasal catarrh : discharge thick yellow greenish, oﬀensive. (Therid, Thuj). DOSAE : From lowest to highest potencies. REPETITION . May be repeated in acute diseases. Single dose of high potency for cons tu onal ailments. DURATION OF ACTION : 40 days (Clarke).

sections.title: Details
sections.content: It is a SPECIFIC remedy for the following condi ons: 1. Fevers : puerperal, sep c, typhoid, malarial, diphtheria; with soreness, the bed feels hard, must change posi on with great restlessness; temperature high; tongue clean, smooth, as if varnished, taste pus-like foe d; pulse abnormally rapid, out of all propor on to temperature. Sep c fever with pulse and temperature out of rhythm either way (Kent); high temperature in typhoid fever from the beginning. Fever with aching in bones not relieved by Eupatorium perf. Dry heat, with restlessness, aching in limbs, be er from mo on and warmth but not relieved by Rhus tox, (Kent). Cons pa on without urging, from impac on of faeces. 2. Intes nal obstruc on : with persistent vomi ng of coﬀee ground, oﬀensive, stercoraceous ma er. 3. Diarrhoea : horrible oﬀensive; brown or black; pathless, involuntary; uncertain when passing ﬂatus. 4. Cons pa on : with complete iner a; obs nate from implica on; in fevers; stool large black, carrion like; small black balls like olives. 5. Dead foetus for days, black; horribly oﬀensive discharge; with retained placenta. 6. Lochia : thin, acrid, brown, very foe d; suppressed, followed by chills, fever and profuse foe d perspira on. 7. Chronic disease : never well since sep c fever following abor on or conﬁnement. 8. Heart troubles : with dis nct consciousness of heart; purring; throbbing, pulsa ng constant in ears, preven ng sleep; cardiac asthenia from sep c condi ons. 9. Obs nate, oﬀensive varicose ulcers of old persons with skin pale, cold, of an ashy colour. 10. When best selected remedy fails to improve the condi on of the pa ent suﬀering from puerperal fever, sep caemia, surgical condi on; ptomaine or sewer gas infec on; diphtheria, typhoid or typhus infec ons. It is a dynamic remedy and acts when the indicated remedy fails due to lack of reac vity of vital dynamic of the pa ent. DOSAGE : 6th to 1 M. REPETITION : May be repeated ll the response to the remedy occurs.

sections.title: Details
sections.content: It is a SPECIFIC remedy for the following condi ons: 1. Bad eﬀects of over-indulgence of alcoholic s mulants: headache, spasmodic hiccough, delirium tremens (give drop doses). 2. Herpes zoster : preceded or followed by inter-costal neuralgia (Mez, Kalm); vesicles have bluish appearance, with great itching, and burning. 3. Pains : sharp, s tching, shoo ng, come in paroxysms; from atmospheric changes; from pleurisy, pneumonia, pleurodynia, intercostal neuralgia, herpes zoster; aggrava on from touch, mo on or turning the body. 4. Ailments from cold air; neuralgias, rheuma c pains, pleurisy, pneumonia; worse from cold, damp or stormy weather; worse in evening; touch, contact, mo on. 5. Violent pains over right eye relieved from walking and mo on. 6. Chronic scia ca is relieved by applying ncture of the remedy to heels of the aﬀected leg. (Boericke). 7. Women : with fear of ghosts cannot remain alone in the evening. 8. Hay fever : with aggrava on of all symptoms in the evening; with burning in eyes and lids; stuﬃness of nose; ngling and crawling in posterior nose; itching in so palate. (Wyetha). 9. Intercostal rheuma sm : worse in cold damp, stormy weather, in evenings, mo on. 10. Day blindness; mist before eyes (Caust, Phos). DOSAGE : Mother ncture in drop doses (10 to 30 drops at a me) for bad eﬀects of alcoholism like delirium tremens. Mother ncture to be applied to the heels of the leg suﬀering from chronic scia ca. 3rd to 30th potency generally. REPETITION : In acute cases a few doses may be repeated ll response to the remedy is no ced. DURATIN OF ACTION : Short.

sections.title: Details
sections.content: It is a CONSTITUTIONAL remedy for pa ents: 1. Infants : with diarrhoea; stools turn green on standing; stools have a sour odour. 2. Children: with sour diarrhoea; sour smell from the body, not removed even a er bathing; den onal troubles, cry and toss about all night; screaming of children with urging for stool. Child impa ent, cries for many things, but petulantly rejects them; fre ul at night only; diﬃcult den on, restless, irritable, peevish; with pale face and sour smell; desires various kinds of food, but cannot eat them; becomes repugnant. Sweats of scalp, constant, profuse, weather asleep or awake, hair is always wet. (Calc c, Sil). 3. Diarrhoea in lying period in women. It is a SPECIFIC remedy in the following condi ons: 1. Colic : with very sour stool; worse when standing worse at once by uncovering an arm or leg; not ameliorated by stool. 2. Diarrhoea during inﬂammatory rheuma sm; desire for stool a er a meal; sour stools. DOSAGE : 3rd to 6th potency or 30th potency. REPETITION : A dose a er every stool may be repeated. DURATION OF ACTION : Not deﬁnite.

Nervous persons who are suscep ble to electric storms, thunder, change of weather, cold and windy weather, anxiety and nervousness. 2. Gouty pa ents : who suﬀer from rheuma c pains, some mes wandering from joint to joint, aggravated during rest; before and during storms; cold and wet weather; and ameliorated from warm wrapping. He can always foretell a thunderstorm. 3. Old people who have suﬀered long from gout. It is a SPECIFIC remedy for the following condi ons: 1. Pains, neuralgias, toothache, facial neuralgia, worse before and during the thunderstorm; worse during ret, wandering pains. 2. Rheuma sm : is worse is stormy weather; chronic rheuma sm of small joints; rheuma c gout; gouty inﬂamma on of great toe. 3. Orchi s with much swelling of the tes cles and crushing pains from cold, si ng on cold stone; a er gonorrhoea; with atrophy of tes cles; indura on of tes cles. Hydrocele with the characteris c symptoms of the remedy. 4. Sleeplessness relieved by crossing of legs. (Rheum). 5. Diarrhoea : in damp cold weather; from fruits. 6. All symptoms reappear in rough weather or stormy weather. DOSAGE : 3rd to 200th. REPETITION : Minimum and single dose; to be repeated when symptoms call for the remedy. DURATION OF ACTION : 35 to 40 days (Clarke).

name: Rhus toxicodendron
author: Mathur

sections.title: Details
sections.content: Snowrose, poison Oak. Source: It is a shrub with erect stem, from two to four feet high. The stem is devoid of root-lets; whereas Rhus Radians is four to thirty feet high, has tortuous stem studed with dark coloured root-lets by which it clings for its support. It belongs to the natural order of Anacardiaceae. Habitat: it is indigenous to North America, from where it was introduced to England. Prepara on: Mother ncture of fresh leaves gathered at sunset just before ﬂowering me. Proved by & Dr Hahnemann.

sections.content: It is a CONSTITUTIONAL remedy for pa ents: 1. Who are extremely suscep ble to cold air; they want to cover the whole body even the head to make air warmer. Ailments from slightest inhala on of cold air; cough; catarrh of nose, throat, larynx, trachea; hay fever, hoarseness, aphonia; ur caria. 2. Allergic to meat: causes eructa ons; pruritus. It is a SPECIFIC remedy in the following condi ons: 1. Cough: dry, incessant, fa guing; worse from change of air or room; exposure to cold; slightest inhala on of cold air; with ckling in throat; hoarseness; aphonia; involuntary urine with cough; involuntary stool with cough; relief from covering the whole body with warm clothes; worse reading touching larynx. 2. Early morning diarrhoea; form 5 to 10 A.M. ; sudden urging driving out of bed in morning; stool painless, profuse, oﬀensive; in pa ents suﬀering from advanced phthisis. 3. Itching of skin: worse from cold or exposure to cold while undressing; be er from warmth. 4. Advanced state of tuberculosis: cough worse from talking; lying down especially on le side; inspiring cold air; be er from covering whole body and the head to make air warmer and bearable; sharp s tching pains through le lung; morning diarrhoea; passes urine or stool with violent cough. 5. Asthma of consump ves : worse at 2 A.M. , cold. 6. Ailments : from tea; meat; exposure to cold; cough only during the day; le sided complaints; distension a er meals; aching in le chest; lump in throat; worse by cold; be er by warmth; worse lying on le side; be er charge of oﬀensive ﬂatus. DOSAGE: 3rd to 30th. REPETITION: bears repe on well.

sections.content: Cold air. Exposure to cold. Catarrh of nose, throat, larynx, trachea, bronchi. Capillary bronchi s. Pneumonia. Plumonary tuberculosis. Inﬂuenza with violent catarrh followed by bronchi s. Hoarseness and aphonia due to accumula on of tough, gela nous mucus; a er exposure to cold. Rheuma c aﬀec ons of joints from cold. Complaints & characteris cs Catarrh: form nose or throat and other mucous membranes; thin, watery, copious mucous discharge; followed by tough, stringy, tenacious, gluey mucus, with morning diarrhoea. Cough : dry, incessant fa guing; worse changing air or room (Phos, Spong). Evening a er lying down; touching or pressing the throat pit; lying on le side (Phos); from slightest inhala on of cold air; covers head with bed clothes to make air warmer; li le or no expectora on. Dry teasing cough from ckling in throat. Sensa on of a lump in throat; descends on swallowing but returns immediately. Raw sensa on in Larynx and trachea when coughing (Caust). sections.content: It is a CONSTITUTIONAL remedy for the following types of pa ents: 1. Rickety children with large head; tardy closure of fontanelles; perspire on head during sleep; face pale; distended abdomen; weak ankles; show in learning to walk; head strong; obs nate; cry when spoken kindly to them; chilly; oversensi ve, nervous, ﬁdgety; anxious nutri onally defec ve; emaciated somnambulism. 2. Adults: anxious, yielding, faint-hearted; chilly; worse from cold; uncovering the head; be er from warmth especially from wrapping up the head; takes cold from exposure of feet (Con, Cupr); want of vital heat, always chilly, even when taking ac ve exercise (Led, Sep,). Restless, ﬁdgety, starts at least noise; easily fa gued wants to lie down; mental labour fa gues; nervous debility; suscep ble to suppura on; every li le injury suppurates (Graph, Hep, Merc, Petr); oﬀensive sweats, hastens suppura on (Hep, Lach, Merc, Phyt, Sil). Touchy, re ring; nipples are small, withered, unexcitable (Sars). It is a SPECIFIC remedy for the following condi ons: 1. Foreign bodies: promotes expulsion of foreign bodies from the ssues; ﬁsh bones, needless, bone splinters. 2. Bad eﬀects of vaccina on: abscesses and convulsions (Thuj). 3. Suppura on with a vent, chronic o s media, abscesses, ﬁstula. 4. Whitlow, blood boils carbuncles, ulcers; ﬁssures ani, great pain a er stool. 5. Ailments: caused by suppressed foot-sweat (Cupr, Graph, Psor); exposure of the head and back to any slight dra of air; chest complaints of stone cu ers with total loss of strength. 6. Ver go: spinal ascending from back of neck to head; as if one would fall forward from looking up. 7. Headache; migraine: since some severe disease of youth; ascending from nape of neck to the vertex extending to the right eye (to the le eye -Spig); worse from exposure of head to cold air; be er from pressure and warmly wrapping the head. (Mag mur, Stron); be er from profuse urina on. 8. Cons pa on: always before and during menses; from inac vity of rectum; with great straining, as if rectum was paralysed; when partly expelled, recedes again (Thuj); faeces remain long me in rectum. 9. Fistula: lachrymalis; ﬁstula and alternates with chest symptoms (Berb, Calc p). 10. Ingrowing toe nails. (Mag. P.a. , Mar v). It is a BIO-CHEMIC ssue remedy according to Schussler: 1. It has aﬃnity to: brain and nerves, glands, bones, mucous membranes, skin, hairs, nails. 2. When a deﬁciency of Silica occurs suppura on is retarded. 3. Imperfect assimila on and defec ve nutri on of the ssues of the body is due to Silica Deﬁciency. DOSAGE: Schussler recommends the 6x and 12x potencies. Kent recommends high and highest potencies when the cons tu onal symptoms are present. It is to be applied externally on ulcers, carbuncles and ulcerated pyogenic parts, for example uterus, in the form of aqueous solu on. REPETITON: Repeated doses are indicated on speciﬁc and biochemic symptoms. Single dose in high potencies, in case of cons tu onal indica ons. DURATION OF ACTION: 40 to 60 days. (Clarke).

sections.content: It is a SPECIFIC remedy for the following condi ons: 1. Hydrophobia: fear of water; swallowing diﬃcult due to constric on and spasms of glo s; convulsions renewed by sight of bright light from a mirror; sight of water; with violent delirium with red face and great loquacity. 2. Typhoid fever: fever con nuous and high mu ering delirium; sings, makes verses; desires to escape; head hot, face red, cold extremi es; eyes wide open, brilliant; sees animals; desires light and company; fearful. 3. Puerperal convulsions: violent; with consciousness; with conges on of head and face and cold extremi es; screams aloud; talking con nually, beseeching, entrea ng; praying, incoherent speech. 4. Basilar meningi s from suppressed ear discharge. 5. Violent headache from walking in the sun. 6. Excrucia ng pain in purulent abscesses. 7. Reten on of urine, cannot pass it if he ceases to strain; in old men who have lost power over the bladder; urine ﬂows slowly. 8. Insanity: mania; with hallucina ons, illusions and delusions; see, ghosts, animals, angels; hears voices, talks to spirits; delusions about iden ty; rapid changes from joy to sadness; furious maniacal delirium with red face and great loquacity; hallucina ons terrify the pa ent. 9. Twitchings of single muscles especially upper part of body. 10. Suppressed menses produce characteris c mental symptoms. 11. Metrorrhagia from retained placenta with characteris c mental symptoms. 12. Tetanic convulsions, worse from touch and bright light. (Cic, Strych). 13. Ailments in which pa ent desires light and company; feels sleepy but cannot sleep; where pains is expected but the pa ent does not complain of pain. (Op). 14. Stammering; has to exert himself a long me before he can u er a word; makes great eﬀort to speak; distorts the face. 15. Cardiac aﬀec on with irregular pulse; sleep full of dreams of turmoil. 16. Child awakens terriﬁed, knows no one; screams with fright, clings to those near. DOSAGE: 6th to 200th potency. REPETITION: May be repeated according to the pace of the disease, but once the response is observed no need to repeat the dose. It is a short ac ng remedy, hence useful in acute diseases. For chronic disease it should be followed by cons tu onal remedy or an -miasma c remedy.

sections.title: Causes & diseases
sections.content: Fright=hysterical convulsions, screams. Shock=cold sweat, child birth=puerperal convulsions, insanity. Sun=headache. Suppression ear discharge=basilar meningi s. Insanity. Mania. Chorea. Convulsions. Meningi s. Abscess. Constric on of throat. Reten on of urine in old people. Cardiac aﬀec ons with irregular pulse, sleep full of dreams and turmoil. Metrorrhagia from retained placenta with characteris c delirium. Tetanic convulsions worse from touch and light. Schiopherania. AFFINITIES; Brain, Nervous system, Circula on, Muscles, Sex organs. Complaints & characteris cs Delirium: mu ering loquacious, talks all the me; violent; sings, makes verses, raves desires to escape, head and face hot and red with cold extremi es; in con nued fevers, typhoid; cerebral conges ons and insanity. When delirium is not on, the face is pallid forehead wrinkled, looks sickly and haggard. Convulsions with consciousness. (Nux v). Insanity: hallucina ons terrify the pa ent; disposed to talk con nually (Cic, Lach); incessant and incoherent talking and laughing; praying, beseeching, entrea ng; with suppressed menses. (Bell, Cham, Op) AGGRAVATION; In the dark, When alone, Looking at bright light or shining objects, A er sleep, (Apis Lach, Op, Spon), When a emp ng to swallow. AMELIORATION; Light and company, Warmth.

sections.title: Details
sections.content: Synonyms : Brimstone-Hindi-Gandhak. Source: It is an element, occurring in nature as a bri le crystalline solid substance in mines or near volcanoes. It is a compound word consis ng of "Sul" meaning salt and "Phur" meaning ﬁre. Hence it means "The salt that burns". It is called "Gandhak' in Hindi because it has a smell of its own, the medicinal proper es of Sulphur were known to Ayurvedic physicians of ancient India who used to prepared and use Makardwaja, a prepara on of Sulphur, Mercury and Gold ton their pa ents. Sulphur is available in the market. Prepara on: Tritura on of "Flower of Sulphur" are prepared with sugar of milk and higher potencies are prepared from 3c. A saturated solu on of sulphur in absolute alcohol cons tutes the mother ncture. Proved by : Dr. Hahnemann. The ﬁrst proving of Sulphur contained 151 symptoms in materia medica pura. Allen Encyclopedia contains 4,083 symptoms.

sections.title: Details
sections.content: IT IS A DEEP ACTION ANTI-PSORIC, CONSTITUTIONAL, AND SPECIFIC REMEDY. ANTI-PSORIC INDICATIONS: It is an An -psoric remedy for the following condi ons: 1. When carefully selected remedies fail to produce a favourable eﬀect, especially in acute diseases. It frequently serves to remove the bad eﬀects of psora and rouses the reac ve powers of the vital dynamic. 2. Complaints that are con nually relapsing due to lack of vital dynamic or reac vity. 3. Chronic ailments due to suppressed erup ons causing asthma, epilepsy, chorea, convulsions, diarrhoea, insanity, dyspnoea, ver go, scrofulous ailments. 4. Suppression of haemorrhoidal ﬂow causing chronic ailments including heart troubles. (Collins). 5. Chronic ailments from suppressed gonorrhoea, i.e. impotency, prosta c troubles. (Med, Thuja). 6. Chronic ailments from suppressed erup ons in acute fevers like small-pox, measles, scarlet fever. 7. Chronic ailments from suppressed discharges like menses, sweats lochia. 8. Drug miasm produced by vaccina on. (Ant t, Sil, Thuja). It is a CONSTITUTIONAL remedy for the following indica ons: 1. Children: dirty, ﬁlthy; aversion to bath; big belly with emaciated limbs; put everything in their mouth; watch every one ea ng; red lips and other oriﬁces of the body; restless at night; kicks the covers oﬀ even inn cold weather; causeless weeping; hungry yet emaciated; foul odour from perspira on; disposed to skin diseases, worm troubles and excoria ng discharges; scrofulous diathesis. 2. Persons of nervous temperament, quick mo oned, quick tempered, plethoric skin excessively sensi ve to atmospheric changes (Allen). The Sulphur pa ent is a lean, lank, hungry, dyspep c fellow with stooping shoulders, yet many mes it must be given to fat, round, well fed people. Persons who lead sedentary life, conﬁned to their rooms in study, in medita on, in philosophical inquiry and who take no exercise, soon ﬁnd out that they must eat only the simplest food and they end up by going into philosophical mania. (Kent) Dirty, shrivelled, red faced people; un dy; not disturbed by unclean lines; oversensi ve to ﬁlthy odours but he eats ﬁlthy substances; he has an exaggerated sense of smell; discharges are of oﬀensive odour, excoria ng the ssues over which they ﬂow; excoria ng leucorrhoea, saliva, lachryma on, stools. 3. Pa ents are warm blooded; complaints come on from becoming warm in bed; burning sensa on is found in conges ons; burning here and there is spots; burning in the glands, organs, stomach or in lungs, burning stool, urine and discharges; burning stool, urine and discharges; burning of the soles of the feet and palms of hand. (Kent). 4. Standing is the worst posi on for Sulphur pa ent; they cannot stand; every standing posi on is uncomfortable (Allen); cramps is calves and soles at night. 5. Sulphur pa ent is too lazy to rouse himself; too unhappy to live. 6. Sulphur pa ents are disposed to: scrofulous, rachi s, catarrhal, bilious, haemorrhoidal disposi ons; tendency to venous and portal conges ons; itchy erup ons. 7. Sulphur pa ents are oxygenoid; they suﬀer from suﬀoca ve a acks at nigh, want the doors and windows open. SPECIFIC indica ons: 1. Diarrhoea: a er midnight; painless; driving out of bed early in the morning, foul smelling; excoria ng anus. 2. Cons pa on: stool hard kno y, dry as if burnt; large; painful. 3. Menorrhagia a er miscarriage. 4. Sick headache every week or every two weeks; prostra ng; weakening; with hot vertex and cold heat. 5. Chronic alcoholism; they reform but are con nually relapsing; dropsy and other ailments of drunkards. 6. Third stage of pneumonia when hapa sa on fails to relapsing; dropsy and other ailments of drunkards. 7. Pleurisy: pericardi s; helps in the reabsorp on of the ﬂuid and plas c exuda ons, in brain or joints when Bryonia or Kali mur fails. 8. Sulphur is a speciﬁc remedy in the following condi ons if the characteris c, cons tu onal or the an -miasma c symptoms are present in the pa ent. Acne; Adenoids; Alcohol habit; Amenorrhoea; Asthma; boils; Chilblains; Cons pa on; Consump on; Diarrhoea; Dysentery; Eczema; Eye aﬀec ons; haemorrhoids Hypochondriasis; Leucorrhoea; Liver disorders; Lumbago; Lupus; Measles; Menstrual disorders; A er-eﬀects of miscarriage pericardi s; Pneumonia; pleurisy; pregnancy disorders; Rheuma c disorders; Self abuse; Skin aﬀec ons; Sleep disorders; Star ng; ur caria; Prolapse of uterus; Vaccina on; Worms. 9. Sulphur should be considered as the remedy in the following condi ons:- As a prophylac c remedy in cholera, malaria, recurrent boils. Threatening phthisis. As an dotal to abuse of metals generally. When syphilis and sycosis are complicated with psosra. When par al relief comes from remedies which have no deﬁnite complementary remedy. To shorten the convalescent period a er acute diseases. When worms are suspected as obstruc on to cure. When there is history of suppressed erup ons. When there is history of suppressed erup ons. When symptoms are le sided. Should be considered when complaints are relapsing; rheuma c complaints (Roberts). When the beneﬁt ac on of other remedies come to a halt. It makes the same remedy work again. (Pierce). When there is in the past history ulcers and other ailments traceable to tuberculosis (Ruddock). Sulphur, Calc c, Lycopodium follow each other well and they should be considered in this direc on in sequence. CONTRA-INDICATIONS: 1. Should not be given in advanced cases of phthisis in high potencies. (Kent) 2. Should not be given at night to persons who do not suﬀer from loss of sleep. 3. Should not be given a er Calc or Aur met as it may spoil the case. DOSAGE : Crude form-it is useful in cases of scabies in the form of sulphur ointment. Low potencies-in asthma, rheuma sm early cases of phthisis. The 12th potency is a good one to begin treatment with, going higher and higher when the symptoms again call for it. Acts in all potencies from lowest to highest according to the suscep bility of each pa ent. 200 or higher potencies in chronic diseases. REPETITON: bears repe on well in certain speciﬁc diseases e.g. haemorrhoids. Single dose of high potencies in chronic condi ons or suppressions. DURATION OF ACTION: 40 to 60 days (Clarke).

When given in primary chancre it ﬁrst aggravates then cures the disease. 2. Ailments in which all symptoms are worse at night; from twilight to daylight. 3. Pains increase and decrease gradually; shi ing and require frequent change of posi on. 4. Leucorrhoea: profuse, soaking through the napkin and running down to the heels. 5. Acute ophthalmia neonatorum; lids swollen, adhere during sleep: pain intense at night agg from 2 to 5 A.M. ; pus profuse; ameliorated by cold bathing. 6. Ptosis: paralysis of superior oblique muscle; sleepy look, from drooping of lids. 7. Craving for alcohol in any form. Hereditary tendency in alcoholics. 8. Obs nate cons pa on for years: rectum seems ed up with strictures; when enemata were used the agony of passage was like labour (Lac d, Tub). 9. Fissures of anus and rectum (Thuj); prolapse rectum with history of Syphilis. 10. When best selected remedy fails to relieve or permanently improved in syphili c aﬀec ons. DOSAGE: 200 to higher potencies. REPETITION: Bears repe on well a er a week in 200 potency. Single dose of CM in chronic cases. In primary chancre one dose of 1 M potency given daily ﬁrst aggravates the chancre for two weeks then gradually the chancre fades away (Thomus Wides). If a er giving Syphilinum the edges of the chancre assume the appearance of proud ﬂesh in the third or fourth week and becomes everted, jagged and angry dark red he gives Lac and CM every night for ten or fourteen days un l the sore takes on a more natural appearance, when Syphilinum 1 M is again given to ﬁnish the case. The a ack would come on only at night a er lying down or during a thunderstorm, and produces the most intense insomnia, en rely preven ng sleep for days and nights together, most of the similar remedies failed. Syphilinum C M cured, (H. C Allen)

sections.title: Details
sections.content: Synonyms: Tubercle bacilli. Mycobacterinum. Tuberculosis Homnis, Bovis and Aviare. Source: Sputum of tubercular persons containing Myco-bacterium tuberculosis which are used in preparing Tuberculinum Homnis. Prepara on of Diﬀerent Varie es of Tuberculin's. 1. Burne 's bacillinum (originally called Tuberculinum) was prepared by Dr. Heath from tubercular ulcer from cow's lung containing tubercular bacilli which were found microscopically hence it was called Bacillinum. It is a prepara on of Bovine tubercular bacilli. In his brilliant book "New Cure of Consump on" Dr. Burne has give his experiences from the use of the remedy. 2. Dr. Kent's Tuberculin was prepared from the infected lymph- glands of ca le. The tubercular glands were removed from the ca le by a veterinary doctor and poten sed by Boericke and Tafel. It is also Myco- bacterium Tuberculosis Bovis. 3. Koch's Tuberculinum was prepared from cultures of Tubercular Bacilli macerated in glycerine broth. It is called Old tuberculin. It was found to be very toxic when given in the form of injec ons hence was rejected by Dr. Koch. He then macerated the Tuberele bacilli in saline solu on and allowed the emulsion to se le down for hours. The prepara ons from the lower layer was called T.R. (Tuberculin Residue). 4. Koch's lymph is prepared from Old Tuberculin of Koch containing T.B. Homnis. It is prepared by Lambert Nelson. It was found to be very eﬀec ve in higher potencies above 200th. 5. Bronchi s of old people with inability to expectorate that large amount of mucus in the chest. 6. For ailments with cold sweats on forehead; face pale, blue, collapsed; features sunken hippocra c; red while lying, becomes pale on rising up; worse from lest mo on; great prostra on; thirst for large quan es of cold water and acid drinks. 2. Cholera: a er fright with profuse sweat, profuse vomi ng, profuse diarrhoea; thirst for large quan es of cold water; cramps; great prostra on; dehydra on. 3. Insanity: violent, tears clothes, shrieks, runs about, spits, exposes person, lewd, lascivious talks, sings obscene songs; preaches, talks rapidly, loquacious; praying loudly, religious mania, corprophagia, repents; anxious about salva on, sits brooding, wailing; puerperal insanity; with uterine and menstrual disorders. Catalepsy from religious excitement. Ero c mania; melancholia; nymphomania in lying women. 4. Diarrhoea: from fright; fruits; watery, gushing, with cu ng colic; with vomi ng, cold perspira on on 5. Mental troubles from injured pride, or honor; disappointed love. 6. Bad eﬀects of opium ea ng or tobacco chewing and alcohol. 7. Intermi ent fever where cold stage always predominates; with blueness of ﬁnger nails; with cold and clammy sweats before the paroxysm begins and lasts un l the next. 10. sections.title: Details
sections.content: It is a SPECIFIC remedy in the following condi ons: 1. Ailments in which hyperaemia or conges on is present; acute inﬂamma ons. Cerebral conges on; cerebrospinal meningi s; conges ve stage of pneumonia; conges ve headache etc; with characteris c symptoms of the remedy, e.g. ﬂushed face, high temperature, bounding pulse, a red streak down the centre of the tongue; inﬂamma on with violent pains. 2. Conges ve apoplexy, hot head, bloodshot eyes, thick speech, slow full pulse, hard as iron. 3. Acute rheuma sm, high fever, full hard rapid pulse; severe pains in joints and muscles; scanty red urine. 4.
